# nico Provider

Provider for the NVIDIA Infra Controller (NICo) REST API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) NICo REST API base URL. Falls back to NICO_ENDPOINT environment variable.
- `org` (String) Organization name used in API paths. Falls back to NICO_ORG environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token for authentication. Falls back to NICO_TOKEN environment variable.
